name: Deploy
oneLiner: Open a pull request and let a person review the real result.
goal: The pull request is the review boundary. A green run is not the merge.

steps.title: Open the pull request
steps.text: Open one pull request for this change. Describe what changed.

steps.title: List the done-checks
steps.text: Write each check and how it was verified, including screenshots when the UI changed.

steps.title: Hand off for review
steps.text: Stop there. A person reviews the real build and decides whether to merge.

doneChecks.text: A pull request is open for this change.
The pull request lists the done-checks and how they were verified.
A person reviews the result. The agent does not merge.

pitfalls.text: Merging before a person reviews the real build.
Treating a green test run as the review.

quotes.text: Deploy uses the pull request as the review boundary.

optionGroups.label: Review boundary
optionGroups.help: Where does a person review this change?

options.label: Pull request
options.detail: One pull request, with screenshots when the UI changed.
options.promptFragment: The review boundary is one pull request. Open it for this change, list the done-checks and how they were verified, and include screenshots when the UI changed. Do not merge. A person reviews and merges.

optionGroups.label: Continuous integration
optionGroups.help: Skip this when CI is already decided.

options.label: GitHub Actions
options.promptFragment: Use GitHub Actions for the checks. https://docs.github.com/en/actions

options.label: No new workflow
options.detail: The reviewer runs the checks locally.
options.promptFragment: Do not add a CI workflow in this change. Name the local commands a reviewer runs.

options.label: GitHub Pages
options.promptFragment: Deploy target: GitHub Pages, publishing the static build. https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/what-is-github-pages

options.label: Local only
options.promptFragment: Deploy target: local only. Do not publish a site in this change.
